scientific_question: Can existing Candidate Period evidence from the controlled source support a scientifically justified identification of one metric-reference periodicity without access to Ground Truth?
direct_contribution_to_jga_mission: Test the first Domain-level metric interpretation required for controlled-source tempo convergence.
missing_scientific_evidence: Evidence that identifies a metric-reference role rather than only the existence, recurrence or coordination of a periodicity.
why_existing_evidence_is_insufficient: F-031, F-032 and C1-04 preserve multiple candidates and descriptive relations but define no metric-reference selector.
smallest_experiment: Audit the frozen C1-03 and C1-04 blind records twice for an existing explicitly authorized metric-role-identifying relation, freeze the blind result, then reveal Ground Truth for validation only.

criterion.unique_support: Exactly one Candidate Period has an existing explicitly authorized evidence relation that identifies its metric-reference role.
criterion.ambiguous: More than one Candidate Period has an existing explicitly authorized evidence relation that identifies its metric-reference role.
criterion.unsupported: No Candidate Period has an existing explicitly authorized evidence relation that identifies its metric-reference role.
